page.overview:
Who is Desiree Traville?

Desiree Traville is a Lasombra and the pack leader of The Ravens, a politically motivated coven in the Sabbat.

Born in 1740 as the daughter of a wealthy merchant in Charleston, South Carolina, Desiree was a mischievous girl who spent much of her time at night with male suitors. One evening shortly after sunset, a young thief attacked her while she was walking home from a friend's house. As he pushed her to the ground, she stabbed him in the neck with a knife she carried, killing him instantly. A watching Sabbat vampire observed the incident, followed her home, and abducted her from her room while she slept to recruit her into the sect.

Since her Embrace, Desiree has seen many Sabbat come and go, managing to outlast most of them. Despite her long tenure, she only recently assumed the role of pack leader, having never wanted the position before. Finding that she genuinely loves the power, she has now set her sights on claiming a bishopric.

Equipment: SIG Sauer P220, Maserati, expensive jewelry
